name: Woof Dog Rescue, Inc.
region_note: CITYWIDE / MULTI-BOROUGH RESCUES (take dogs from any borough)
notes: 501(c)(3) since 2003 (founder Rhoda Glass), ACC New Hope partner. Pulls adoptable dogs and cats from the NYC shelter system into foster homes for medical care, re-socialization, and retraining. Small, high-touch, relationship-driven (adopters report lifelong support). Process: email application -> meet & greet. Fee $350. Adopts NY/NJ/CT (exceptions for the right home).
